pages.text: $(l)Recipe$()$(br)Epiphany: defeat a mob with affixes for the first time while wearing Sage's Gift.$(br2)$(l)Made at$()$(br)Basic altar: Alchemical Essence (main) + Coal, Copper, Iron and Gold Ingots, Diamond, Redstone, Lapis Lazuli. Makes 3.

$(l)Uses$()$(li)Hold it in the inventory and right-click a stack that can be smelted: you get the smelted result at once, each with a 30% chance to double.$(li)Right-click a creature with it to transmute it into another.$(li)Turning affix materials into others on a transmutation altar uses it.
